hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Middle East, peninsula bordering the Persian Gulf and Saudi Arabia || mostly flat and barren desert || the peninsula occupies a strategic location in the central Persian Gulf near major petroleum deposits || Resources: petroleum, fish, natural gas || Exports: natural gas, crude petroleum, refined petroleum, plastics, fertilizers (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat and barren desert || Middle East, peninsula bordering the Persian Gulf and Saudi Arabia

climate.excerpt: arid; mild, pleasant winters; very hot, humid summers || haze, dust storms, sandstorms common

economy.excerpt: high-income, oil-and-gas-based Middle Eastern economy; implementing “National Vision 2030” government strategy for economic development, diversification, and favorable business conditions to boost investment and employment; expansion of LNG sector expected to boost growth; Islamic finance leader || Exports: natural gas, crude petroleum, refined petroleum, plastics, fertilizers (2023) || Industries: liquefied natural gas, crude oil production and refining, ammonia, fertilizer, petrochemicals, steel reinforcing bars, cement, commercial ship repair
